description: This file defines the class EmailsDataAddress, which provides functionality to generate data arrays related to email address attributes and signatures within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for assembling email-related data considering encodings and signature resolution.

classes.name: EmailsDataAddress
classes.description: A class that provides methods to generate email address data arrays, including handling signatures and encoding conversions.

methods.name: getDataArray
methods.description: Generates a structured array of email address data, integrating signature HTML and plaintext, and encoding conversion for specified attributes.

methods.name: getDataArrayAttributes
methods.description: Prepares and encodes email address attributes into an array suitable for use in email data structures.
